"description": "The floor a run must clear, as a PERCENT in [0, 100]: 80 means 80%. `minimumPassRatePercent` is the canonical
spelling (the unit is in the name); `minimumPassRate` is the deprecated alias for it. Send exactly one. THE NAME DISAMBIGUATES THE
UNIT: a value in (0, 1) is accepted on `minimumPassRatePercent`, where it unambiguously means a sub-1% floor the evaluator can ac
t on, and REJECTED on the bare `minimumPassRate`, where `0.8` cannot be told apart from a fraction sent by mistake and would silen
